userStories.title: Fix auto_scale not triggering for large batches with restored checkpoint
acceptanceCriteria: When checkpoint restores retry budget with attempts, scaling still occurs for current batch size
Batch of 175 videos results in max_attempts >= 350 (175 * 2.0 attempts_per_video)
Log message shows scaled max_attempts when batch_size > original max_attempts
Add test: restore budget with 50 attempts used, new batch of 200, verify scaling to 400
ensure_scaled() considers remaining budget headroom, not just current max_attempts
userStories.notes:
COMPLETED: Fixed bug in ensure_scaled() (src/caption/retry_budget.py lines 1015-1096).

Root Cause: When checkpoint restored batch_size=175 but caption_stage.py kept max_attempts=100 from config (line 316 comment: 'Keep max_attempts from config'), the old idempotency check `if self.batch_size == batch_size` would skip scaling because batch_size matched, even though max_attempts was insufficient.

Fix: Changed idempotency check to `if self.batch_size == batch_size and required_attempts <= self.max_attempts`. Now scaling occurs even when batch_size is pre-set, if max_attempts is insufficient.

Added 3 tests in TestCaptionRetryBudgetEnsureScaled:
1. test_ensure_scaled_after_checkpoint_restore_with_batch_size_set_but_max_attempts_default
2. test_ensure_scaled_after_restore_200_videos_50_attempts_used (AC4)
3. test_ensure_scaled_considers_remaining_budget_headroom (AC5)

All 265 tests in test_caption_retry_budget.py pass.
